title: Spanning Structures in Multipartite Graph Traversals
summary: Let $G$ be an $r$-partite graph such that the edge density between any two parts is at least $α$. We consider the problem of determining how large $α$ must be in order to guarantee that $G$ has a Hamiltonian traversal (an $r$-cycle subgraph containing exactly one vertex from each part), and show that this critical density tends to $\frac 1 2$ as $r$ increases. This resolves a conjecture of Badakhshian, Falgas-Ravry, and Sharifzadeh.
